gloss: to become emaciated; to waste away; to grow thin

definitions.gloss: to become emaciated; to waste away; to grow thin
definitions.explanation: To lose weight dramatically and become very thin, often due to illness, hardship, or lack of food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やせ{細|ほそ}ってしまった。
やせ{細|ほそ}った⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧にいた。
examples.english: An emaciated cat was by the roadside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧やせ{細|ほそ}って、⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぶかぶか→ぶかぶか：20573_bukabuka⟧になっていた。
examples.english: During the hospital stay, I wasted away so much that after discharge my clothes were baggy.

notes:
An emphatic compound verb formed from やせる (to lose weight) and {細|ほそ}る (to become thin). It conveys a more extreme, pitiable state of thinness than やせる alone — not simply being slim, but being unhealthily thin. Often used sympathetically to describe someone who has suffered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やせ{細|ほそ}った⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧: an emaciated body
- やせ{細|ほそ}った⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧: thin, wasted arms
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧やせ{細|ほそ}る: to waste away completely
- ⟦みるみる→みるみる：21458_mirumiru⟧やせ{細|ほそ}る: to waste away visibly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やせる: to lose weight; to become thin — the standard, neutral verb for getting thinner
- ⟦{痩|や}せこける→痩せこける：22637_yasekokeru⟧: to be gaunt; to be skin and bones — even more extreme than やせ{細|ほそ}る
- げっそり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become haggard — an onomatopoeic expression emphasizing a drawn, hollow-cheeked appearance
